hook.text: A language model has to finish this sentence. [curious] So... which word comes next?

logits.text: First, it gives every candidate a score, called a logit. Say cat scores three point two... and rock scores minus zero point four.

softmax.text: Then softmax turns those scores into probabilities. It raises e to each score, and divides by the total. Cat gets sixty-five percent... and rock gets under two.

divide.text: Temperature divides every score, before the softmax. The order never changes... only the shape does.

low.text: Below one, the gaps between the scores grow. At zero point two, cat takes over ninety-nine percent!

greedy.text: And at zero, it always takes the top token. That's greedy decoding.

high.text: Above one, the gaps shrink, and the bars even out. At one point five, rock rises to almost five percent.

draw.text: Now let's draw twenty tokens at each setting, from the same twenty random numbers.

draw-low.text: At zero point two? All twenty come out cat.

draw-high.text: At one point five, cat wins only eleven. Dog, bird... and even rock get a turn.

topp.text: Top p adds a guard. Keep the likeliest tokens until they cover ninety percent... and drop the rest.

topp-cut.text: At one point five, that keeps cat, dog and bird. Rock is cut before the draw.

rule.text: So turn temperature DOWN when there's one right answer, like extraction or code. And turn it UP when you want variety.
